hook: Alexandr Wang founded Scale AI in June 2016 and built it into a data platform for AI. In June 2025 Scale AI announced that he was joining Meta to work on its AI efforts after a large Meta investment in the company, with Wang staying on Scale's board. His LinkedIn profile, which still lists him as Scale AI's CEO, is out of date on that point.

quick_facts: Founder of Scale AI in June 2016, which his LinkedIn profile describes as the data platform for AI
Joined Meta in June 2025 to work on its AI efforts, according to Scale AI's announcement of June 12, 2025, which also named Jason Droege interim CEO of Scale
Remains a director on Scale AI's board, per the same announcement
Wikipedia lists his Meta title as Chief AI Officer, leading Meta Superintelligence Labs, and a Financial Times profile of October 2026 described him as a central figure in Meta's AI effort
Earlier worked at Hudson River Trading and Addepar and was a tech lead at Quora from 2014 to 2016, per his profile
A USACO finalist and a participant in the USA Mathematical Talent Search, per his profile

achievements.impact: Meta made a significant investment in Scale AI that valued it at over 29 billion dollars, and Wang moved to Meta while keeping his Scale board seat.
